sites.name: Cave Lake Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $15 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.season: Facilities open as weather permits; usually early July to late October.
sites.about: The Campground at Cave Lake is little used and the perfect place for a week-end or week long getaway.
sites.directions: From Lakeview, Oregon go south 14 miles on US Hwy 395 and into California to County Road 2. Turn east on County Road 2 and continue for 7 miles to the campground. From Alturas travel north on US Hwy…
sites.restrictions: Dogs on leash only. Please clean up afeeter your dog. Garbage service is not provided. Please take all trash, garbage, fish guts and dog droppings with you when you leave. Camping limit 14 days.
sites.reservations: Reservations are not accepted. All sites are first come, first served. $15/night

sites.name: Deep Creek Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.about: Deep Creek campground is located in the South Warner Mountains, one hour 25 minutes southeast of Lakeview, Oregon.
